notes.text:
This update for vsftpd fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-119567: access control bypass allows authenticated FTP users to execute denied commands by issuing RFC 775
  X-prefixed aliases (bsc#1288995).
- CVE-2026-119568: authentication bypass in `ssl_data_accept()` allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack FTPS data
  connections by resuming their own TLS session ticket (bsc#1288996).

notes.text: vsftpd through 3.0.5 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated FTP users to execute denied commands by issuing RFC 775 X-prefixed aliases. The cmds_denied check in process_post_login() compares literal tokens, so attackers can send XRMD, XMKD, XCWD, XPWD, or XCUP to perform blocked operations like deleting directories.

notes.text: vsftpd through 3.0.5 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ssl_data_accept() that allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack FTPS data connections by resuming their own TLS session ticket. Attackers sharing the victim's source IP can obtain a ticket via AUTH TLS, then connect to the victim's PASV port to steal downloads or inject upload data.
